crew.overview: Brought back to life by an unorthodox scientist, a young woman runs off with a lawyer on a whirlwind adventure across the continents. Free from the prejudices of her times, she grows steadfast in her purpose to stand for equality and liberation.
crew.title: Poor Things

details.biography: Shona Heath is a British art director and set designer, born in May 1974. After graduating from Brighton University in fashion design (1997), she transitioned into set design, renowned for her surreal, magical creations. Collaborating with photographer Tim Walker for over 20 years, she crafted iconic visuals for Vogue and brands like Dior. As production designer with James Price for Poor Things (2023), she won an Oscar and BAFTA for her imaginative sets. Known for blending surrealism with intricate details, Heath’s work spans exhibitions, fashion, and film.
details.name: Shona Heath
